```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

ANALYSIS_DIR <- if (dir.exists("data") && file.exists("data/ou_tracking_fits.csv")) {
  "."
} else {
  "analyses/K00_GemcitabineExposure_033023"
}
OU_FITS_CSV <- file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "data/ou_tracking_fits.csv")

order_dose_label <- function(label, dose) {
  dose_levels <- sort(unique(dose[is.finite(dose)]))
  factor(label, levels = paste0(dose_levels, " nM"))
}

format_ploidy <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = sort(unique(x)))
}
```

```{r load-data}
ou_fits_raw <- read_csv(OU_FITS_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

for (missing_col in setdiff(
  c(
    "n_starts", "seed", "start_id", "best_start_id", "start_tau",
    "start_velocity_scale", "start_obs_noise", "delta_loglik_next_best",
    "n_converged_starts"
  ),
  names(ou_fits_raw)
)) {
  ou_fits_raw[[missing_col]] <- NA
}

ou_fits <- ou_fits_raw |>
  mutate(
    ploidy = format_ploidy(ploidy),
    gemcitabine_label = paste0(Gemcitabine, " nM"),
    gemcitabine_label = order_dose_label(gemcitabine_label, Gemcitabine),
    clean_fit_status = if_else(grepl("^converged", fit_status), "converged", fit_status),
    log_likelihood_per_segment = log_likelihood / n_segments,
    log_likelihood_per_track_time = log_likelihood / total_track_time
  ) |>
  arrange(job_id)

best_fit_summary <- ou_fits |>
  group_by(job_id) |>
  summarize(
    best_log_likelihood = max(log_likelihood, na.rm = TRUE),
    second_best_log_likelihood = suppressWarnings(sort(log_likelihood, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[2]),
    n_converged_starts = sum(clean_fit_status == "converged", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    second_best_log_likelihood = if_else(is.finite(second_best_log_likelihood), second_best_log_likelihood, NA_real_),
    delta_loglik_next_best = best_log_likelihood - second_best_log_likelihood
  )

best_fits <- ou_fits |>
  group_by(job_id) |>
  slice_max(order_by = log_likelihood, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(best_fit_summary, by = "job_id") |>
  mutate(
    best_start_id = start_id,
    delta_loglik_next_best = coalesce(delta_loglik_next_best.y, delta_loglik_next_best.x),
    n_converged_starts = coalesce(n_converged_starts.y, n_converged_starts.x)
  ) |>
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y"))

parameter_long <- best_fits |>
  select(
    job_id, fit_label, ploidy, Gemcitabine, gemcitabine_label, fit_status,
    tau, velocity_scale, effective_diffusivity, obs_noise
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tau, velocity_scale, effective_diffusivity, obs_noise),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = c("tau", "velocity_scale", "effective_diffusivity", "obs_noise"),
      labels = c("Tau", "Velocity scale", "Effective diffusivity", "Observation noise")
    )
  )
```

## Inputs

This report reads:

```text
`r OU_FITS_CSV`
```

These are condition-level OU velocity-model fits. Rows may be in Slurm
job-completion order. New multistart outputs have one row per start attempt, so
the main plots use the highest-likelihood start for each condition.

```{r fit-status-table}
ou_fits |>
  count(clean_fit_status, name = "n_start_attempts")
```

## Fitted Parameters

```{r fitted-parameters-by-dose, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
ggplot(
  parameter_long |> filter(is.finite(value)),
  aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = value, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Gemcitabine",
    y = "Fitted value",
    color = "Ploidy"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r fitted-parameters-log-scale, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
ggplot(
  parameter_long |> filter(is.finite(value), value > 0),
  aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = value, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Gemcitabine",
    y = "Fitted value, log10 scale",
    color = "Ploidy"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Fit Support

```{r multistart-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
multistart_data <- ou_fits |>
  count(job_id, ploidy, Gemcitabine, gemcitabine_label, name = "observed_starts") |>
  left_join(
    best_fits |>
      select(job_id, best_start_id, n_starts, delta_loglik_next_best, n_converged_starts),
    by = "job_id"
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(delta_loglik_next_best))

if (nrow(multistart_data) > 0) {
  ggplot(multistart_data, aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = delta_loglik_next_best, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      x = "Gemcitabine",
      y = "Best log likelihood - next best",
      color = "Ploidy"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r fit-support, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
support_long <- best_fits |>
  select(job_id, ploidy, Gemcitabine, gemcitabine_label, n_segments, total_track_time) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_segments, total_track_time),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("n_segments", "total_track_time"),
      labels = c("OU segments", "Total track time")
    )
  )

ggplot(support_long, aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = value, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Gemcitabine",
    y = "Support",
    color = "Ploidy"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r log-likelihood, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
ggplot(best_fits, aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = log_likelihood, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Gemcitabine",
    y = "Log likelihood",
    color = "Ploidy"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r normalized-log-likelihood, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
likelihood_long <- best_fits |>
  select(
    job_id, ploidy, Gemcitabine, gemcitabine_label,
    log_likelihood_per_segment, log_likelihood_per_track_time
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(log_likelihood_per_segment, log_likelihood_per_track_time),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("log_likelihood_per_segment", "log_likelihood_per_track_time"),
      labels = c("Log likelihood / OU segment", "Log likelihood / total track time")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  likelihood_long |> filter(is.finite(value)),
  aes(x = gemcitabine_label, y = value, color = ploidy, group = ploidy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Gemcitabine",
    y = "Normalized log likelihood",
    color = "Ploidy"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Fit Table

```{r fit-table}
best_fits |>
  select(
    job_id, fit_label, ploidy, Gemcitabine, fit_status,
    tau, velocity_scale, effective_diffusivity, obs_noise,
    log_likelihood, log_likelihood_per_segment, log_likelihood_per_track_time,
    n_starts, seed, best_start_id, start_tau, start_velocity_scale,
    start_obs_noise, delta_loglik_next_best, n_converged_starts,
    n_segments, total_track_time
  )
```
